name: Cultist: Wicked Thoughts grants 15% max mana, run speed and mounted speed through native stock auras (#3023)
contract: 706190 (SpellFamilyName 31, self-target) has three stock 3.3.5a auras with no CoA-specific handler: effect0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED (31) BasePoints=14 -> CalcValue 15; effect1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MOUNTED_SPEED_NOT_STACK (172) BasePoints=14 -> CalcValue 15; effect2 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_ENERGY_PERCENT (132) MiscValue=0 (POWER_MANA) BasePoints=14 -> CalcValue 15. run_speed_rate and max_power (README's metric table) directly observe effect0 and effect2. The harness has no mounted-speed metric, so effect1 is asserted through aura_amount instead, per the README's fallback for mechanisms without a dedicated metric. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.

steps.label: SETUP: Wicked Thoughts' mounted-speed effect is absent before it is learned
Wicked Thoughts raises run speed by 15% (#3023)
Wicked Thoughts raises maximum mana by 15% (#3023)
Wicked Thoughts installs a 15-point mounted-speed aura effect; the harness has no mounted-speed metric (#3023)
